note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 3768 Section 7.2 says "Fill in the VRRP packet fields with the appropriate virtual router configuration state - Compute the VRRP checksum". TestEncodeGoldenV2 gained only the FillChecksum mode argument, and FillChecksum seeds a pseudo-header only when the version nibble is 3, so the VRRPv2 encode still has to equal the golden G1 byte for byte, checksum 0x92ED included. Single-polarity positive. Verdict unchanged.
